metadata.title: Ralion | Project Onboarding Buddy
metadata.description: Project onboarding for admins, HR, product managers, and software engineers.

landing.lede: Accelerate technical onboarding by mapping your repository, documentation, and team conventions into an interactive knowledge network. Stop digging through outdated wikis.
landing.introBody: Ralion acts as your team's AI onboarding buddy. It automatically connects the dots between your codebase, scattered documentation, and implicit team conventions, creating a living knowledge base that answers questions before they're asked.

preview.label: Preview of the Ralion assistant experience
preview.question: What is this project's pull request review process?
preview.answer: Every pull request needs at least one approval, green CI, and no direct merge to the main branch.

benefits.groundedBody: Every response traces back to the relevant document, code, or team convention.
benefits.journeyBody: Turn scattered knowledge into a clear onboarding checklist for every project.
benefits.livingBody: Keep pace with repository and document changes instead of relying on stale wikis.

landing.workflowLead: A seamless pipeline from code to knowledge.

steps.indexBody: Continuously ingests codebase history, PRs, and architectural decisions directly from your version control.
steps.mapBody: Extracts implicit team rules, coding standards, and connects scattered document fragments into a cohesive graph.
steps.guideBody: Provides interactive, context-aware answers to new hires directly in their workflow, reducing friction.

landing.rolesLead: Built for every member of the engineering organization.
landing.roleHr: Streamline onboarding metrics and ensure smooth culture integration for every new engineering hire.
landing.rolePm: Accelerate time-to-productivity for new team members and significantly reduce mentor burnout.
landing.roleMember: Get instant answers to technical and contextual questions without constantly pestering senior engineers.

cta.title: Turn the first week into a guided journey.
cta.body: Bring team knowledge to the right person at the right moment, always with trustworthy context.

landing.introHeading: Shorten the time from day one to first contribution.
landing.introText: Ralion connects codebases, project documents and team conventions into an ordered, source-backed, accountable onboarding journey — replacing scattered wikis and repetitive 1:1 support.
landing.f1TitleRest: written in detail by AI from real documents.
landing.f1Body: PM selects an engineer, AI analyzes project documentation and generates a comprehensive roadmap — each task includes goals, steps, expected deliverables, and verified source citations.
landing.f2Body: Engineers can ask any question — from accessible project docs, company policies (HR, IT, Security) to team conventions. Ralion provides answers with direct citations to verified documentation. No hallucinations, no ambiguity.
landing.f3TitlePost: to Onboarding Completion — everything in reach.
landing.f3Body: PM tracks milestone progress, receives instant blocker alerts, resolves obstacles in time, and confirms onboarding completion. Engineers always know their next step with clarity.
landing.rolePmBody: Initialize projects, manage documents, review AI-generated candidate plans, assign tasks to new hires, and track blocker resolutions.
landing.roleEngBody: Follow an actionable task checklist, query project docs & company policies via RAG chat, update progress, and report blockers when stuck.
landing.roleHrBody: Manage new hire rosters, oversee policy acknowledgement across teams, and monitor technical cultural integration progress.
landing.roleAdminBody: Manage user accounts, assign system role permissions, configure resource integrations (repositories, documents), and oversee workspace security.
landing.nlText: Sign in and set up your first project today.
landing.footerTagline: Project-aware onboarding buddy for engineering teams.
